hypotheses_definitions.H1: ITQ 128-bit + Hamming re-rank significantly outperforms raw FAISS IndexLSH at equal RAM (16 bytes/vec), verified via Wilcoxon signed-rank test.
hypotheses_definitions.H2: LSH Wrapper (RAM bitcode + disk memmap) achieves significantly lower query latency than Disk Flat Float16 (M2) on >=200k scale by eliminating sequential disk I/O.
hypotheses_definitions.H3: On small scale (<=50k), Exact In-Memory is faster; on >=1M scale, LSH-Wrapper surpasses Exact In-Memory in query throughput due to O(N*b/64) POPCNT complexity reduction.
hypotheses_definitions.H4: Recency decay (alpha=0.7) preserves recent facts (dt<=200) near semantic upper bound, but experiences systematic degradation on older facts (dt>2000) relative to pure semantic mode (alpha=1.0).
